data.exact_reserve_text: Prior year movements of GBP 5.8m in 2014, comprising GBP 5.4m adverse movements in claims reserving and GBP 0.4m movement in premiums, net of reinsurances

prior_year_events.event_name: RITC brought forward from close of 2011 year of account
prior_year_events.impact_description: Movement on the RITC brought forward from the close of the 2011 year of account contributed to prior year movements recorded in 2014

A 2010 case, vigorously defended at the start of the year, was forced into settlement by reinsurers and contributed to Sterling prior year movements; net of reinsurance recoveries this claim settled at GBP 1.1m

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded adverse prior-year reserve movements in 2014, with an adverse movement in claims reserving of GBP 5.4m (part of a total prior-year movement of GBP 5.8m). The deterioration was driven predominantly by liability claims (notably UK and Canadian liability awards and the settlement of a 2010 case), and included an impact from a movement on the RITC brought forward from the close of the 2011 year of account. Overall this resulted in a net strengthening of reserves versus the opening gross claims outstanding.
raw_causal_phrases: Prior year movements of GBP 5.8m in 2014, comprising GBP 5.4m adverse movements in claims reserving and GBP 0.4m movement in premiums, net of reinsurances
The remaining movements in the closed years in calendar year 2014 have largely stemmed from UK and Canadian liability awards, and to a lesser extent, Irish liability awards

Of the Sterling movement GBP 1.8m related to the 2010 year of account where one case which was being vigorously defended at the start of the year was forced in to a settlement by the reinsurers. Net of reinsurance recoveries, this claim settled at GBP 1.1m.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from balance sheet (2013 comparative column). There is no dedicated 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note showing a gross total; prior year development is inferred from Managing Agent narrative which states a GBP 5.4m adverse movement in claims reserving (part of a GBP 5.8m total prior-year movement). The reported figures in the narrative do not explicitly state gross vs net for every element; the prior_year_development_gbp_m uses the GBP 5.4m adverse claims-reserving figure as a gross strengthening (confidence moderate). No claims development triangle was present in the provided pages to cross-check.
